name: BinaryCanary
line: Checks websites, email, ports, DNS, and certificate or domain expiry.

uptime.math: The Standard plan includes 10 locations. The monitoring part for 5 endpoints is $5 per 30-day billing cycle.
The Power plan includes 30 locations. The monitoring part for 25 endpoints is $10 per 30-day billing cycle.
The Hyper plan includes 100 locations. The monitoring part for 100 endpoints is $20 per 30-day billing cycle.
